title: Forget Utopia
question: What must be true for this promise to work?

deckRating.reason: Durchgehend sauber geschriebenes Deck mit stimmigem Tonfall und klarem Wissenskern pro Karte (Halo-Effekt, Verlustaversion, hedonische Anpassung, Pre-Mortem), aber die Power-Texte sind fast durchweg Rhetorik statt Spielhandlung und viele Bilder bebildern nur den Titel. Stark sind die Tier-Pointen (Mausefallen-Tastatur, Sekretärvogel, Windhund mit Banner).
deckRating.ratingNote: 4 + 5 Sterne zusammen 16 von 56 (29 %), knapp unter der Grenze von 30 %; nach Prüfung gegen die Tabelle gehalten. Power erreicht nur auf den Karten 34, 53, 54 und 56 die volle Punktzahl, weil die übrigen Power-Texte Haltungen statt klarer Handlungen beschreiben.

bewertung.viralReason: „The Hero Demo“ (Lemur auf der Mausefallen-Tastatur) und „The Moving Launch Date“ (Windhund jagt das Banner) würden geteilt, weil jeder Tech-Pitch das Bild sofort wiedererkennt.

marketing.blurb: A card deck that names the rhetorical moves used to sell futures that never arrive. For anyone who has ever stood in a line to nowhere and wondered exactly how they got there.

cards.power: Hold up a future so polished the visitor sees their own face in it. Sell the reflection.
cards.lore: A scale model of tomorrow is easily mistaken for a measurement of it.

rating.reason: Chamäleon vor seinem Spiegelbild in der Glaskuppel trägt das Bild; die Power ist Rhetorik ohne Handlung. Der Lore-Satz vom Modell, das mit einer Messung verwechselt wird, ist zitierbar.

cards.gradeReason: Chameleon in bubble = you ARE the reflection being sold. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: chameleon gazing into iridescent dome, sees own distorted reflection. Mood: seductive, uncanny.

cards.power: Show the destination as already built. No scaffolding, no mud, no maintenance, no Tuesday.
cards.lore: The render is an argument dressed as a photograph of something that does not yet exist.

rating.reason: Der Pudel allein in der blank polierten, leeren Stadt macht „kein Dienstag“ sofort sichtbar. Lore („Argument, als Foto verkleidet“) steht allein.

cards.gradeReason: 'No scaffolding, no Tuesday' — the absence named is the move. Zero-setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: poodle sitting pristine in perfect glass city plaza, no workers, no weather. Mood: uncannily clean, hollow.

cards.power: Make today feel like a waiting room with bad chairs, so the future feels like rescue.
cards.lore: Re-framing the present as merely an obstacle devalues the only time anyone can actually act in.

rating.reason: Eintagsfliege im Wartezimmer mit schlechten Stühlen und Regenbogen hinter der Tür: Motiv und Text sagen dasselbe, und das Insekt macht „vergehende Gegenwart“ zur Pointe. Lore ist nur im Kartenkontext stark.

cards.gradeReason: Dragonfly in waiting room is soft — metaphor reads conceptually before it performs.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: dragonfly slumped on plastic chair in grey waiting room, rainbow door in background. Mood: drained, wistful.

cards.power: Offer the dream. Ask only that they stop looking at the floor and sign.
cards.lore: Awe and scrutiny use different states of mind, and awe is faster.

rating.reason: Krake mit Stift am Vertrag ist solide, aber erwartbar. Die Lore (Staunen und Prüfen sind verschiedene Zustände) bleibt vage.

cards.gradeReason: 'Awe is faster' is a single-sentence PhD thesis. Octopus with pen clinches it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: octopus holding glowing pen over contract scroll, eyes wide in wonder. Mood: dazzled, complicit.

cards.power: Promise that one product retires an entire category of human suffering.
cards.lore: Recasting complex social problems as neat technical fixes flatters the tool and ignores the politics.

rating.reason: Walross hakt „Hunger, Einsamkeit, Tod“ am Pult ab: Der Haken bei Death ist der Gag. Lore nennt Solutionismus, aber ohne Begriff.

cards.gradeReason: Walrus checking HUNGER/LONELINESS/DEATH boxes is great; the logic needs one beat to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: walrus at podium checking off enormous checkbox list including DEATH, city skyline behind. Mood: preposterous, ceremonial.

cards.power: Draw a straight line from now to paradise. Hide the cliffs behind the font.
cards.lore: Roadmaps present uncertain futures as scheduled milestones, borrowing the authority of a train timetable.

rating.reason: Raupe auf der Route zum Abgrund passt, ist aber vorhersehbar. Der Zugfahrplan-Vergleich in der Lore ist der beste Teil.

cards.gradeReason: Caterpillar on dotted path to UTOPIA sun with cliff gap is strong; slightly standard metaphor.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: fuzzy caterpillar on glowing milestone path, massive cliff gap hidden behind soft mist, UTOPIA sun on far side. Mood: optimistic, treacherous.

cards.power: Let salvation slip one quarter, then another. Keep the faith by keeping the date close.
cards.lore: Breakthroughs said to be a few years away sustain belief precisely by never arriving.

rating.reason: Windhund jagt ein Banner, daneben ausgestrichene Quartalsdaten und „SOON!“: Bild und Titel sind eine Pointe. Lore („nie ankommen als Glaubensstütze“) ist zitierbar.

cards.gradeReason: Greyhound chasing 'ALMOST THERE' with crossed-out Q3 2023/2024/2025/SOON = instant recognition.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: racing greyhound mid-sprint, scoreboard of crossed-out launch dates trailing behind it. Mood: frantic, tragicomic.

cards.power: Collect belief up front. Deliver the future on a later invoice, or not at all.
cards.lore: Trading on anticipation is a practice old enough to have a name: vaporware.

rating.reason: Nager mit Vorbestellungs-Zetteln in der Schlange ist verständlich, aber ohne Dreh. Die Lore endet auf „vaporware“, das trägt.

cards.gradeReason: 'Vaporware' lore payoff is sharp; hamsters queuing at empty storefront needs reading to fully snap.

cards.power: Aim everything bright and warm. Let the glare do the editing.

rating.reason: Motte am Scheinwerfer ist das bekannte Bild. Wissenskern: Debords Gesellschaft des Spektakels, konkret genannt.

cards.gradeReason: Lemur at keyboard is charming; 'happy path' concept needs one breath to activate.

cards.gradeReason: Seals clapping with lone owl not clapping — solid image but social proof concept needs moment.

rating.reason: Pinguinreihen mit Abzeichen und ein leerer Stuhl, ordentlich, aber ohne eigene Pointe. Lore bleibt allgemein.

cards.gradeReason: Sloth in velvet chair beside chained door is good; 'destination stays exactly as far away' needs the lore.

rating.reason: Nilpferd vor einer bunten Tierschar passt zu „nasser Decke“, aber ohne Überraschung. Lore („Kritik als Kleingeist abtun, ohne die Frage zu beantworten“) ist treffend.

rating.reason: Strauß zieht den Kopf aus dem Loch, die Bären feiern: guter Dreh, aber Lore und Power bleiben generisch.

cards.lore: Continually deferring satisfaction spends the present as a means, never an end.

rating.reason: Biber baut ein Haus aus Kredit- und Schuldenkarten: Kartenhaus als Bild trägt. Text bleibt sonst Behauptung.

cards.gradeReason: Beaver building house of credit/debt/borrow cards is rich visual; 'ships late' lore grounds the move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: beaver carefully stacking house of credit cards labelled DEBT/FUTURE/BORROW, rainbow outside, structure swaying. Mood: industrious, precarious.

cards.power: Charge attention as rent on a building with no keys.
cards.lore: Attention spent on anticipation is a finite resource drained without return.

rating.reason: Specht vor Messgerät „ATTENTION“ und verschlossener Tür erklärt die „Patience Tax“ nicht. Die Lore ist ein Füllsatz.

cards.gradeReason: Woodpecker at attention meter + locked door is inventive but 'rent on building with no keys' needs unpacking.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: woodpecker pecking at attention gauge while ornate door stays locked, gauge needle dropping. Mood: metered, draining.

cards.power: Add up the Tuesdays spent in the waiting room.
cards.lore: The cost of perpetual anticipation is invisible because it is paid in ordinary, un-itemized hours.

rating.reason: Eichhörnchen schreibt „WAITED, STILL WAITING“ auf den Kassenzettel: gute Idee, aber zu leise umgesetzt.

cards.gradeReason: Squirrel writing 'WAITED/WAITED/STILL WAITING' on infinite receipt is poignant; invisibility needs the lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: squirrel writing on endless receipt scroll, each line reading WAITED, Tuesday after Tuesday scrolling off table. Mood: careful, invisible cost.

cards.power: Present the total gently, after the lights are warm and the doubt is gone.
cards.lore: Costs disclosed amid positive affect at the close of a pitch receive the least scrutiny.

rating.reason: Taube überreicht Rechnung „$ INFINITE + TAX“ und gurrt: höfliche Zumutung, sitzt. Inhaltlich dasselbe wie Karte 12.

cards.gradeReason: Pigeon delivering invoice to warm-lit table is quietly sharp; positive-affect mechanism needs the lore read.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: cooing pigeon sliding $ INFINITE + TAX invoice under warm lamplight to unsuspecting recipient. Mood: warm, gently predatory.

cards.power: Remove every visible seam, so the labor and the trade-offs disappear.
cards.lore: Hiding the seams of a system hides its workings, leaving users unable to contest what they use.

rating.reason: Gürteltier als nahtlose Glaskugel ist sauber gelöst. Die Lore („Nähte verstecken heißt Funktion verstecken“) ist nur Behauptung.

cards.gradeReason: Armadillo curled into perfect sphere rolling blind = hidden seam IS the form. Instant body knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: armadillo rolled into flawless ball careening across landscape, all seams invisible, joints concealed. Mood: smooth, unknowable.

cards.power: Leave no room for a question. If you cannot ask, you are inside the pitch.
cards.lore: A presentation that absorbs every objection in advance leaves no opening for genuine inquiry.

rating.reason: Axolotl in der Seifenblase ist reine Illustration ohne Witz. Power („wer nicht fragen kann, steckt im Pitch“) ist als Gedanke gut, hier nur beschrieben.

cards.gradeReason: 'If you cannot ask, you are inside the pitch' — axolotl in bubble = perfect enclosure of the idea.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: bewildered axolotl sealed in pristine bubble, cracks forming from outside questions bouncing off. Mood: airtight, no exit.

cards.power: Offer one path forward and call it the future.
cards.lore: When only one route is presented, a manufactured choice is being disguised as an inevitability.

rating.reason: Wombat vor Karte mit nur einem freien Pfeil passt, ist aber vorhersehbar. Lore („inszenierte Wahl als Zwangsläufigkeit“) ist treffend.

cards.gradeReason: Capybara on map with single glowing arrow is clean; 'manufactured choice as inevitability' needs lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: capybara studying map with single illuminated route, all alternative paths blacked out. Mood: confident, foreclosed.

cards.power: The shinier it is, the harder you should look for the floor.
cards.lore: Sufficiently advanced presentation acts like magic, and magic works precisely by hiding the mechanism.

rating.reason: Rabe blinzelt in eine gleißende Kugel. Lore („Magie funktioniert, indem sie den Mechanismus verbirgt“) ist zitierbar.

cards.gradeReason: Best single line in the deck. Crow with gleaming orb = corvid wisdom about surfaces. No setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: crow circling a blinding iridescent sphere, tilting head to find where it stands. Mood: skeptical, drawn, searching.

cards.power: Name every quiet if the promise stands on.
cards.lore: Surfacing the load-bearing ifs a pitch keeps hidden is the core of a pre-mortem audit.

rating.reason: Giraffe vor Turm mit „IF“ im Gerüst passt. Power („Nenne jedes stille Wenn“) ist klar ausführbar, Wissen bleibt angedeutet.

cards.gradeReason: Giraffe with IF/IF/IF tower is conceptually accurate but 'quiet if' phrasing needs unpacking at table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: giraffe peering at tower of IF blocks holding up impossible utopian structure, each block labeled. Mood: analytical, precarious.

cards.power: Find the one assumption that, if false, drops the whole roof.
cards.lore: Identifying the single most fragile assumption tells you more than admiring the finished facade ever could.

rating.reason: Nashorn vor rissigem Bogen ist stimmig. Power („die eine Annahme finden, die das Dach trägt“) ist klar spielbar.

cards.gradeReason: Rhino in crumbling arch = one creature, one keystone, entire structure. Embodiment is the card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: rhinoceros standing in cracked triumphal arch, entire facade held by its presence alone. Mood: load-bearing, precarious.

cards.power: Ask who is already paid whether or not tomorrow arrives.
cards.lore: Many who sell a future are compensated on the promise rather than the delivery; for them, arrival is optional.

rating.reason: Geier reicht den Beutel „REWARDS“, die Vogelmenge jubelt: wer wird bezahlt, ob es kommt oder nicht. „For them, arrival is optional“ ist zitierbar.

cards.gradeReason: Vulture receiving REWARDS bag over crowd is sharp; 'arrival is optional' mechanism needs the lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: vulture in spotlight receiving bulging REWARDS bag from podium while crowd below cheers for a future not yet delivered. Mood: compensated regardless.

cards.power: Hold the brochure up to the light. Count the things that have to be true. Notice how many are not.
cards.lore: A promise is only as sound as its hidden assumptions.

rating.reason: Der gelbe Hase zieht den Vorhang vom Gerüst: Schlusspointe, Bild und Aufgabe passen. Power gibt drei klare Schritte.

cards.gradeReason: FrizzleBob pulling curtain on unfinished city = perfect closer. Power IS the instruction. Exhibition gold.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit pulling back billboard curtain to reveal unfinished scaffold city behind glossy render. Mood: revelatory, impish.
